title: 第十五章 通脉三重第十六章 水到渠成
content_zh:
引气丹入口便化作了一道温暖的气体，迅速在姜云的体内流转，融入四肢百骸，让其觉得浑身舒泰，耳清目明，甚至连感觉都敏锐了许多。
紧接着，姜云的脑海之中也浮现出了《通脉决》的口诀：“坐而忘我，抱元守一，开生死之桥，连天地灵气……”
渐渐的，姜云的呼吸开始变得绵远悠长起来，身体也是越来越轻，彷佛飘飘荡荡，进入到了另一片天地之中，浑然忘我。
也不知道过去了多久之后，他的一呼一吸之间，明显可以感觉到有着一缕清凉之气，从外界涌来，顺着他的口鼻进入了身体，并且在他的体内游走一圈之后，慢慢的沉浸在了丹田之处。
“灵气！”
姜云的心中一动，立刻意识到这清凉之气，就是对于修士修炼之根本，藏于天地之间的灵气！
感应到灵气并且引入体内，这就说明自己已经真正成功的迈出了修道的第一步，而接下来他要做的，就是引入更多的灵气，从而逐条打通自己那闭塞的经脉。
这个发现让姜云感到开心的同时，也是有了疑惑。
既然爷爷说过自己的体质不能修炼姜族功法，那么在姜云想来，能够让自己修炼的功法，恐怕都是那种极为罕见，甚至举世难寻的。
可是东方博说的很清楚，这《通脉决》和引气丹都是最常见之物，哪怕不入宗门，稍微花费点钱财都能买到。
如此普通的修炼之物，竟然就让自己可以修炼了？
虽然疑惑，但姜云也知道现在不是胡思乱想的时候，所以他很快就将这些念头暂时抛开，继续专心感应吸收灵气。
与此同时，在藏峰峰顶之上的一间小屋之中，同样盘膝闭目而坐的东方博，猛然睁开了双眼，看向了姜云所在的位置，眉毛一挑，自言自语的道：“生平第一次修炼，竟然在这么短的时间里就完成了引气入体！难道，这次我捡回了一个宝贝？”
随着东方博话音的落下，在他的耳边却突然响起了一个女人的声音：“大师兄，这就是你找的四师弟？不是很怪啊！”
对于这个声音，东方博丝毫不觉得惊讶，笑了笑道：“没有道心，道灵不具，道体不通，还不够怪吗？至于是不是四师弟，那就要看他和师父有没有缘了！”
女声顿了顿道：“如此说来，倒的确有点怪！不过，不管他和师父有没有缘，如果他在修道之上能够入我眼的话，那我也不介意指点他一下！”
东方博点点头道：“难得二师妹能青睐此子，我自然没有意见！不过，他对修道一窍不通，这几天还是先让我好好给他讲解讲解，二师妹如果有兴趣的话，也可以过来旁听一下，你也不能老是闭关修道，这样对你没有好处，二师妹？二师妹？怎么不说话了？”
等了片刻，二师妹的声音再没有响起，这让东方博略微不满的摇摇头道：“真是的，我这是为你们好，你们还嫌我啰嗦，看样子，只有姜老弟懂我，恩？”
东方博的语气突然一变，而那半天没有响起的女声也是再次响起，声音之中充满了惊讶：“竟然已经打通了第一条经脉？这，怎么可能！”
“轰！”

姜云只觉得自己体内猛然传出了一声剧烈的爆响，一条闭塞的经脉竟然被灵气给打通了。
“通脉，一重？”
姜云自己也愣住了，因为东方博说的很清楚，哪怕能够将灵气引入体内，但是要想打通经脉，还需要相当长的时间。
content_en:
The entrance to the Qi-Entraining Pill turned into a stream of warm gas, which quickly circulated in Jiang Yun's body and blended into his limbs, making him feel comfortable all over, his ears and eyes clear, and even his senses became much sharper.
Immediately afterwards, the formula of "Tongmai Jue" also appeared in Jiang Yun's mind: "Sit and forget yourself, hold Yuan Shouyi, open the bridge of life and death, connect the spiritual energy of heaven and earth..."
Gradually, Jiang Yun's breathing began to become longer and longer, and his body became lighter and lighter, as if he was drifting into another world, completely forgetting himself.
I don't know how much time passed, but with every breath he took, he could clearly feel a ray of cool air coming from the outside world, entering his body along his mouth and nose, and after swimming around in his body, he slowly immersed himself in his Dantian.
"Aura!"
Jiang Yun's heart moved, and he immediately realized that this cool air was the spiritual energy hidden between heaven and earth that was the foundation of monks' cultivation!
Sensing the spiritual energy and introducing it into his body, this means that he has truly successfully taken the first step in cultivating the Taoism. What he has to do next is to introduce more spiritual energy to open up his blocked meridians one by one.
This discovery made Jiang Yun feel happy but also confused.
Since grandpa said that his physique cannot practice the Jiang Clan's Kung Fu, then Jiang Yun thought that the Kung Fu that he could practice would probably be extremely rare or even hard to find in the world.
But Dongfang Bo made it very clear that the "Tongmai Jue" and the Qi-Entraining Pill are the most common things. Even if you don't join the sect, you can buy them with a little money.
Such an ordinary cultivation object actually allows me to practice?
Although he was confused, Jiang Yun also knew that now was not the time to think wildly, so he quickly put aside these thoughts for the time being and continued to concentrate on sensing and absorbing spiritual energy.
At the same time, in a small room on top of the Zangfeng Peak, Dongfang Bo, who was also sitting cross-legged with eyes closed, suddenly opened his eyes, looked at Jiang Yun's position, raised his eyebrows, and said to himself: "This is the first time I have practiced in my life, and I have completed the introduction of Qi into my body in such a short time! Could it be that I picked up a treasure this time?"
As Dongfang Bo finished speaking, a woman's voice suddenly sounded in his ear: "Senior Brother, is this the Fourth Junior Brother you are looking for? Isn't it weird!"
Dongfang Bo was not surprised at all by this voice, and smiled and said: "Isn't it strange enough that he has no Taoist heart, no Taoist spirit, and no Taoist body? As for whether he is the fourth junior brother, it depends on whether he has a predestined relationship with the master!"
The female voice paused and said, "It's a bit strange to say so! However, regardless of whether he has a relationship with the master or not, if he can catch my eye in terms of cultivation, then I don't mind giving him some advice!"
Dongfang Bo nodded and said: "It's rare for Second Junior Sister to favor this boy, so I naturally have no objection! However, he knows nothing about cultivation. He should let me explain it to him these days. If Second Junior Sister is interested, you can also come and listen. You can't always practice Taoism in seclusion. This will not be good for you. Second Junior Sister? Second Junior Sister? Why don't you talk?"
After waiting for a moment, the second junior sister's voice did not sound again, which made Dongfang Bo shake his head slightly dissatisfied and said: "Really, I am doing this for your own good, and you still think I am verbose. It seems that only Brother Jiang understands me, huh?"
Dongfang Bo's tone suddenly changed, and the female voice that had not sounded for a long time also sounded again. The voice was full of surprise: "The first meridian has been opened? How is this possible!"
"Boom!"
Jiang Yun felt a violent explosion suddenly come from his body, and a blocked meridian was opened by spiritual energy.
"Tongmai, first level?"
Jiang Yun himself was stunned, because Dongfang Bo made it very clear that even if spiritual energy could be introduced into the body,It will take quite a long time to open up the meridians.
